title: Traditional Turkish-Style Doner Kebab
description: A classic Turkish dish made with thinly sliced lamb, served in a crispy sesame-topped bun with fresh vegetables. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be prepared within an hour.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to slice the lamb thinly

ingredients.name: Lettuce
ingredients.notes: Chopped lettuce adds a fresh crunch

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Chopped tomatoes add a burst of flavor

ingredients.name: Red pepper
ingredients.notes: Chopped red pepper adds a sweet crunch

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for added flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality olive oil for added flavor

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the sesame-topped buns with olive oil and grill until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced lamb, chopped onion, lettuce, tomatoes, and red pepper.
Add the garlic mixture to the lamb mixture and mix well.
Form the lamb mixture into a large cylinder and place it on the grill.
Cook the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 63°C (145°F).
Once the lamb is cooked, slice it thinly and serve in the crispy sesame-topped buns.
